verdict.rationale: Adyen documents prefunded balance models: a single pool of funds for all card payments, or a balance per card, held in balance accounts linked to cards. Relayed authorisation lets your system approve or decline each authorization in real time within 2000 ms, with fallback logic. However, nothing shows your system funding each authorization just-in-time, and no cash-flow tradeoffs between models are documented. Missing for 10: just-in-time funding of individual authorizations, documented guidance on cash-flow tradeoffs between funding models, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can choose how transactions are funded — prefunded balances or just-in-time funding where my system approves and funds each authorization — with the cash-flow tradeoffs documented

citations.quote: Use a single pool of funds for all card payments or maintain balances per card.
Relayed authorisation allows you to make a real-time decision on whether to approve or decline a transaction.
With each relayed authorisation webhook we send, you have up to 2000 milliseconds to reply with an approval or a refusal.
